metadata.name: fallback-fidelity
metadata.description: Cross-rung output fidelity benchmark for the Zouroboros healer fallback chain. For each task, calls every rung of the target chain and scores output against tier-specific gates. Verifies that downgrade targets produce usable output for swarm-flavored workloads.
metadata.purpose: Q2 #5 §3.9 family (b) — budget-cap downgrade fidelity. When Sonnet is unhealthy and the healer flips an agent to Kimi-K2.5 (open-weight rung) or zo:smart (terminal rung), do those rungs actually produce reasonable output for our workloads? Without this benchmark, fallback is opaque past the unit-invariants layer.
